newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel to issue T$2.5-5.0 bln bonds.
newsitem.headline: China Steel to issue T$2.5-5.0 bln bonds.

text.p: China Steel Corp, Taiwan's largest steelmaker, said on Thursday it would issue T$2.5-T$5.0 billion in five-year non-guaranteed corporate bonds next week to raise funds for its routine operations.
The firm has invited interested underwriters to attend an auction for the bonds on June 2.
"The actual size of the issue and bond yields will be decided after the auction," a China Steel executive, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
"The funds will be used for routine company operations," he said.
Previously state-owned China Steel was privatised in April 1995.
